patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports difficulty in combing hair and reaching objects on high shelves for the past few months. Admits to a sedentary lifestyle.

Secondary_Symptoms: Decreased range of motion in shoulder

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Diabetes mellitus type II, obesity, hypertension. On metformin, insulin, lisinopril, and hydrochlorothiazide.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Sedentary lifestyle, predominately staying indoors and watching television.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies recent injuries or trauma to the arm or shoulder. No fever, weight loss, or other joint involvement.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with stiffness in his arm impacting daily activities.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, for the past few months I’ve noticed stiffness in my arm, especially making it hard to comb my hair and reach items on high shelves. My shoulder range of motion feels decreased, and my arm strength feels like about 4 out of 5.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any change in the shape or contour of either breast—such as one breast looking different from before, becoming uneven, or changing in size or shape?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any change in the shape or contour of my breasts—no unevenness or change in size that I can tell.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Have you had any abdominal (belly) pain recently?**
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had any abdominal or belly pain recently.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had diarrhea recently—meaning loose or watery stools more than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t had diarrhea or any loose or watery stools more than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Are you having **profuse sweating**—for example, sweating so much that your clothes or bedding become noticeably wet, even when you’re not doing heavy physical activity?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I don’t think I’m having profuse sweating—no episodes where my clothes or bedding get noticeably wet, and it hasn’t seemed worse than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your wrist? (Yes or No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I don’t currently have pain in my wrist.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you usually have morning stiffness that lasts **more than 30 minutes** after you wake up? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—my morning stiffness doesn’t last more than 30 minutes after I wake up.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a breast lump or mass that feels **fixed in place**—meaning it doesn’t move much when you gently press it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any breast lump or mass that feels fixed in place, and I haven’t felt anything unusual when I gently press.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have any pain in your knee (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I don’t currently have pain in my knee.”
